limitations: OSM objects can be retrospective and do not establish a historical location by themselves.
Name, address and commune agreement do not prove identity or historical timing.
The targeted audit does not validate the unused systematic examples or the national directory.
metadata.method: Every point displayed for the El Salvador case is retained as a distinct observation and compared with the frozen OSM education snapshot through institutional Nominatim. A candidate never overwrites the official point.
